sources.title: Existing Boracay weather page – legacy beach marker dataset
sources.limitations: Coordinates and broad coast classifications were carried over from the existing weather page. These are legacy map markers, not independently surveyed beach centroids or verified boundary points.

sources.title: Boracay Map – Tourism Promotions Board Philippines
sources.limitations: The PDF identifies itself as a tourist map, says it must not be used as an official reference, and states information was accurate as of April 2020. Its Beach / Dive Site index supports map labels and grid references only; it does not establish surveyed beach boundaries, exact centroids, current access, or present-day conditions.

sources.title: Recreational Waters Monitoring Program: Annual Water Quality Assessment Report, Boracay Island, January–December 2022
sources.publisher: DENR Environmental Management Bureau Region VI
coverage: Ilig-Iligan Shell Museum sampling station coordinates
Annual fecal-coliform geomean and compliance statistics for 2022
2022 quarterly oil-and-grease averages and compliance statistics for monitored stations
Ralph's Place station water-quality results; linked to Bulabog Beach by SRC-010
sources.limitations: Historical monitoring data from January–December 2022. Sampling stations are not necessarily co-located with the whole beach; station coordinates must not be treated as beach centroids. Fecal-coliform results cover 12 sampling events; oil-and-grease monitoring was quarterly (April, June, September and November). Results must not be presented as current water quality or current bathing safety.

sources.title: Environmental Performance Report and Management Plan – Boracay Island Water Supply System Project
sources.publisher: DENR Environmental Management Bureau Region VI
sources.limitations: Report describes monitoring station locations and historical water quality; not a real-time beach safety bulletin.

sources.title: Boracay Island Hopping Tour – seasonal meeting point information

sources.title: Overview of the beaches of Boracay – Hagdan Beach section
sources.limitations: Secondary travel-guide source. It supports use of the place name and provides a descriptive access account, but is not an authoritative boundary, access-rights, or coordinate survey.

sources.title: Assessment of Benthic Macrofauna and Sediment Characteristics of Boracay Island, Philippines
sources.publisher: Sustainable Aquatic Research; University of the Philippines Visayas authors
sources.limitations: Field sampling was conducted in October 2022 at three White Beach stations only. It does not provide surveyed beach boundaries, beach width/slope, bathymetry, or a current island-wide ecological status. Station coordinates are research sampling points, not beach centroids.

sources.title: Regional State of the Brown Environment Report 2021 – Western Visayas
sources.publisher: DENR Environmental Management Bureau Region VI
coverage: Ralph's Place regular ambient monitoring station
Lapuz-Lapuz Beach historical ambient monitoring station coordinates
CY 2006–2019 historical station table: Lapuz-Lapuz Beach
CY 2006–2019 historical Bulabog Beach station at a different coordinate
CY 2020-onwards station table: Ralph's Place with station name Bulabog Beach
sources.limitations: The report contains two distinct station inventories: Table 4.53 covers CY 2006–2019, while Table 4.54 covers CY 2020 onwards. Table 4.53 lists Lapuz-Lapuz Beach and an older Bulabog Beach station at 11°56′08″N, 121°55′39″E. Table 4.54 lists Ralph's Place as a regular ambient station with the station name Bulabog Beach at 11°58′09.0″N, 121°55′38.4″E. These records must not be conflated. The report supports station identity and historical metadata, not beach boundaries or current water quality.
